integrity: A complete standalone exact-rational checker and analytical proof are supplied. Finite tests are corroborative, and no independent historical-priority or correctness assessment was performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal seasonal retention for two infected classes, deterministic exact discrete-time linearization and known positive directed-transfer coefficients. The result does not prove nonlinear persistence, continuous-time seasonal propagation or real-data infection dynamics; a broader earlier matrix-rearrangement theorem may still cover its identities.
title: Four-season pair-matching law and separated invasion thresholds for bidirectional vector–host transmission
